subject: Chile
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about the shape of Chile. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). The widths are the article’s mainland figures.

claims.text: Chile stretches over 4,300 km (2,670 mi) north to south.
It is only 350 km (217 mi) at its widest point east to west and 64 km (40 mi) at its narrowest point, with an average width of 175 km (109 mi).
Chile extends along a narrow strip of land between the Andes Mountains and the Pacific Ocean.
Chile is the southernmost country in the world and the closest to Antarctica.
